name: Remote Access to Live Engagements
description: Real-time audio capture and live transcript monitoring for Zoom Contact Center voice engagements

display_information.long_description: An engagement dashboard that captures live engagement audio, transcript, and events for admin management and control. Stream audio to browsers with sub-second latency, display real-time transcripts, and track metrics including hold time, transfers, and conferences. Admins have remote control over when media stream capture starts and stops, with real time insight and analytics.

scopes.description: Read real-time audio streams from Contact Center voice engagements via RTMS
Start and stop RTMS capture for specific Contact Center engagements
Read real-time transcripts from Contact Center voice engagements

event_subscriptions.description: Triggered when a Contact Center voice engagement begins - enables Start/Stop buttons in PWA
Triggered when a voice engagement ends - resets engagement state and counters
Triggered when agent places customer on hold - updates hold tracking counters
Triggered when agent removes customer from hold - updates hold timer
Triggered when RTMS capture begins - establishes WebSocket connections to Zoom media servers
Triggered when RTMS capture ends - converts raw PCM to WAV files
Triggered when agent initiates transfer - tracked in event counts on dashboard
